description: Opens the navigation drawer, in the leading slot of the screen's top bar and only below the drawer breakpoint. `<PageHeader>` renders it when the screen has no `onBack`, and `<ChatShell>` does the same for a screen with its own bar — which is why nothing outside this package has ever imported it and nothing should. It is `` for that reason and not because it is unfinished: shared, maintained and tested like anything else, and simply not a name to choose between.
